findings.description: The call to extract_zipped_paths on DEFAULT_CA_BUNDLE_PATH was removed, so the default CA bundle path is used as-is. If it points inside a zip archive (zipapp, zipimport), it is not extracted to a real file.
findings.rationale: Trigger: requests is run from a zipped package (zipapp or egg) with verify=True and no custom CA bundle. DEFAULT_CA_BUNDLE_PATH is then a path inside the zip, so os.path.exists fails and an OSError about a missing CA bundle is raised. HTTPS requests fail. The new comment says certifi extracts the file, but that holds only if certs.where() itself extracts it, which this diff does not show.
